title: Q13 Sequence of statements on taming science
subject: Environment
caption: Flowchart illustrating the four possible orderings of statements P, Q, R, S and highlighting the correct sequence.
altText: A flowchart starts with a Start node leading to a decision node labeled 'Choose correct option'. Four branches represent Option A, B, C, and D. Option A branch shows the sequence P → Q → R → S ending at End and is highlighted. Option B shows P → R → Q → S, Option C shows Q → P → R → S, and Option D shows P → Q → S → R, all converging to the same End node.
